first_frame.notes: One keyframe opens the clip exactly.

last_frame.notes: Can pin an ending keyframe together with the first frame.

first_last_frame.notes: Two keyframes may pin exact start and end.

timed_keyframes.notes: Up to 10 keyframes can be pinned at exact moments.

soft_reference_image.notes: Current public release uses images as clip keyframes, not general Omni identity/style references.

reference_video.notes: Existing video is supported as v2v continuation source, not as an arbitrary motion-reference bundle.

reference_audio.notes: Current public endpoint has no arbitrary audio-reference mode; future Omni Reference is on roadmap.

video_continuation.notes: mode=v2v; official launch describes up to 4 seconds of existing video/audio context.

native_audio.notes: Speech, effects and ambience generated with frames.

native_multi_shot.notes: Multiple scenes and camera angles in one generation.

typography.notes: Accurate text/typography is a stated capability; exact brand-critical text still requires QC.

draft_enhance.notes: mode=draft_enhance preserves selected draft at full quality.

video_upscale.notes: Separate FLUX Upscale tool can regenerate up to 4K.

omni_reference.notes: BFL docs say image/video Omni Reference will be available later; do not treat current keyframes as soft references.

notes: I2V keyframes are literal/pinned frames of the generated clip, not general soft references.
FHD is finished through BFL's video upsampler.
FLUX 3 result URLs are signed and expire quickly; download promptly.

knownRisks: Current official BFL documentation explicitly labels FLUX 3 as a preview model even though the initial generation endpoint is publicly available.
Current public endpoint does not expose general soft image/video/audio Omni Reference yet.
Using identity/product reference portraits as literal keyframes may force unwanted composition; prebake shot keyframes instead.
V2V is continuation from a short source context, not general motion-reference transfer.
FHD and later 2K/4K upscale stages need preservation QC.

notes: T2V/I2V whole-second durations 5–20; V2V whole-second output 5–15.
Multiple scenes/camera angles are supported, but no provider timestamp syntax contract equivalent to H3 is documented.
V2V creates a new 5–15s continuation from up to 4s of existing video/audio context.
Model continuation as new segments with external assembly for long-form SmartAIHub sequences.
